Name: Recording Extras
Author: LetsTalkRose
Description:
[size=4][u][center][b]"Recording Extras" by LetsTalkRose[/b][/center][/u][/size]A simple map that allows content creators to get shots of their farmer for use in chroma keying. It adds a green, blue, red and white background that are 24x24 tile in size as well as some basic info at the bottom of the map. 

[size=4][center][b][u]Installation[/u][/b][/center][/size]To install this mod you require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. Once you have them installed, simply place the mod inside of the [i]Mods[/i] folder.

[size=4][center][b][u]Usage[/u][/b][/center][/size]At the moment, the only way you can access the screens is via the console. These are the commands you would need:
[center][b][u]Green Screen[/u][/b] :: debug warp Custom_Recording_Studio 11 11
[b][u]Red Screen[/u][/b] :: debug warp Custom_Recording_Studio 36 11
[b][u]Blue Screen[/u][/b] :: debug warp Custom_Recording_Studio 11 36
[b][u]White Screen[/u][/b] :: debug warp Custom_Recording_Studio 36 36
[b][u]Info Area[/u][/b] :: debug warp Custom_Recording_Studio 1 49
[/center][size=4][center][b][u]Crediting[/u][/b][/center][/size]If you use this mod when creating a video, credit in the description would be appreciated (but not required). Feedback / suggestions is also welcome and may be implemented. Feel free to comment links to your videos and I may add them to the mod description.
